Abu Bakr refuses Fatima her inheritance from the Prophet's Fai, as prophets leave only charity; Umar, judging Ali and Abbas, explains how the Prophet and his successors managed that property.
Bani an-Nadir's properties came to the Prophet without a Muslim expedition and were his alone; he took his wives' yearly expenses from them, the rest going to arms and horses.
Ali and Abbas disputed the Bani Nadir property before Umar, who said the Prophet's property is not inherited but charity, and must be managed as he and Abu Bakr did.
